principle: Record raw resources first. Do not invent a universal scalar conversion between tokens, proof search, tests, CPU/GPU, memory and human work. Scalarization is experiment-specific and must be frozen prospectively.
accounting_rules: zero means measured zero; null means unavailable/not-applicable and must not be silently treated as zero
every failed/censored target retains resource receipts up to termination
development/acquisition/maintenance work is separate from target-serving work but included in lifetime accounting
external verifier work is charged even though verifier authority remains external
foundation-model/tool work performed for OCM preprocessing or learning is charged
parent and treatment arms use identical coordinate definitions
public benchmark infrastructure may be excluded only if genuinely identical/free to every compared arm and the exclusion is stated
no post-outcome price vector may be chosen to flip a Pareto comparison

aggregation.per_arm: report solved/admissible coverage plus coordinate distributions; never average only successful targets without explicit censoring treatment
aggregation.lifetime: sum development + serving + maintenance + revision according to frozen attribution rules
aggregation.scalarization: optional; requires named price_or_utility_contract frozen before protected outcome access
